title: The monotonicity and unimodality conjecture for the derivative of $F_z$
statement: Let $F_z(s)$ be the function arising from the limiting gap distribution in the paper, defined for $s\in(0,1)$, and let $F'_z$ denote its derivative. **The monotonicity and unimodality conjecture.** If $z\in(0,1)\cup(1,2]$, then $F'_z$ is monotone increasing; if $z>2$, then $F'_z$ is unimodal, with its maximum attained for some $\delta\in(0,1)$. The existence and continuity of the derivatives are established in the surrounding discussion, but the stated shape properties are only suggested numerically and remain open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.06002

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2018).
source_name: Ofir Gorodetsky and Brad Rodgers, “The variance of the number of sums of two squares in F_q[T] in short intervals”, arXiv:1810.06002 (2020).
